name: Craze
long_description:
Craze is the AI video platform where creatives make something people watch.

Brands, creators, agencies and studios use Craze to storyboard, edit, design and turn creative direction into social media content, ads, films and more.

Craze comes with an agent you direct, access to all top video/image/music/audio/media models, and a full timeline editor. You can also use Craze with your Chatgpt, Claude, Muse or other personal agents via Craze MCP.
one_liner: The AI video platform where creatives make something people watch
